title: Leadership Skills for HR Managers
overview: Many organizations overlook HR when it comes to strategic decision-making, largely due to the perception that HR lacks the necessary skills and strategic value compared to other functions. This course is designed to equip HR professionals with six key HR leadership competencies, enabling them to lead their departments effectively, secure a seat at the decision-making table, and contribute to the organization's success. Participants will learn how to transform HR into a strategic function that drives business outcomes.
audience: This course is ideal for HR managers and professionals looking to enhance their leadership capabilities and earn a strategic role within their organizations. It is particularly suited for HR professionals with over five years of experience in various HR functions
methodology: This workshop-based course begins with a SWOT analysis of the HR function within participants' organizations, followed by the identification of the necessary skills and competencies to enhance both personal and departmental leadership. The course focuses on developing participants into value-adding HR leaders.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Connect internal HR processes with external business expectations
Understand and apply six key HR competencies to become effective, value-adding managers
Use modern tools to assess and develop HR leadership competencies
Utilize HR analytics to generate business intelligence and reduce risks associated with human capital
Build an HR department that aligns with business goals and delivers measurable results
